question: Reach competition standard (SH>=2) WHILE regularized (avoid overfit)?
finding: Full winsorize(std=4) regularization caps the non-IV 7-factor mega at SH~1.90 (rw2.5, decay4) - robust & decay-stable (rw2: d4/d5/d6/d8 = 1.80/1.77/1.74/1.68) but BELOW the 2.0 competition bar. Winsorize costs ~0.3-0.4 Sharpe (clips informative tails).
tension: Competition standard (>=2.0) and full regularization conflict for non-IV at delay=0. Either: (a) winsorized robust ~1.9 (misses 2.0), or (b) non-winsorized 2.22 (meets 2.0, moderate tuning).
